cues.zh: 看这枚金色链节。它绕过链轮，把踏板的转动，一路传到后轴。
cues.en: Follow the gold link. Around the sprockets it goes, carrying your pedal motion to the rear axle.

cues.zh: 靠近一点看。链节的间距没有变，每一颗齿，都要刚好接住它。
cues.en: Come a little closer. Every gap in the chain is the same, so each tooth has to meet it precisely.

cues.zh: 现在换小飞轮。同样踩一圈，后面转得更多了。不过，速度是用力换来的。
cues.en: Now a smaller rear sprocket. One pedal turn makes more turns at the back. That extra speed costs you torque.

cues.zh: 换成大飞轮，再看看。走得慢一点，但每一下更轻松。这就是爬坡时的交换。
cues.en: Go larger instead. Less distance per pedal turn, but less effort each time. That's the trade for climbing.

cues.zh: 盯住这个像素，我们把外壳打开。
cues.en: Watch one pixel. Let's open the printer.

cues.zh: 先给鼓面充电。这时，还没有图案。
cues.en: An even charge first. No image yet.

cues.zh: 看，激光扫过，图案先变成电位差。
cues.en: Here comes the laser, writing a voltage pattern.

cues.zh: 碳粉靠过来，图案终于看得见了。
cues.en: Toner moves in. Now the image becomes visible.

cues.zh: 接力！碳粉离开鼓面，来到纸上。
cues.en: The handoff! Toner moves from drum to paper.

cues.zh: 还没粘牢呢。热和压力，让它留下来。
cues.en: Still loose! Heat and pressure make it stay.

cues.zh: 最后清掉残粉，鼓面就能再用一圈。
cues.en: Clean off the leftovers. Ready for another round.

cues.zh: 冰箱里的热要搬到外面。先看压缩机，它用电做功，把蒸气压得又热又密。
cues.en: That heat needs a way out. First, the compressor does work on the vapor, raising its pressure and temperature.

cues.zh: 到了背后的管路，热交给房间，蒸气慢慢变成液体。所以，冰箱背面会热。
cues.en: In the pipes behind the fridge, heat flows into the room and vapor becomes liquid. That's why the back feels warm.

cues.zh: 接下来，穿过毛细管。压力一下降，部分液体闪蒸，温度也降了下来。
cues.en: Next, the narrow capillary tube. Pressure drops, some liquid flashes into vapor, and the mixture gets colder.

cues.zh: 回到箱内，它一边蒸发，一边吸热。再看一眼账本：搬出的热，加上电功，都去了房间。
cues.en: Inside, evaporation absorbs heat. Check the balance: heat from the cabinet, plus electrical work, all ends up in the room.

cues.zh: 先看最上面这道波。空气的压力一起一伏，就是声音。
cues.en: Start with the top wave. Air pressure rises and falls. That's sound.

cues.zh: 再加一道一样的波，会安静吗？看下面，反而更响了。
cues.en: Add another wave just like it. Quieter? Look below. It actually gets louder.

cues.zh: 把它错开半圈，让波峰对上波谷。看，叠加的结果，平下来了。
cues.en: Shift it half a cycle. Peaks meet troughs. Watch the sum settle into a flat line.

cues.zh: 可是，只要晚到一点点，就对不齐了。真正的降噪，最怕这种时机上的偏差。
cues.en: But let it arrive just a little late, and the match breaks. Timing is everything here.

cues.zh: 知道离卫星多远，就知道位置了吗？看，还有一整圈可能。
cues.en: One distance gives a whole circle. So where on that circle are you?

cues.zh: 再来一个距离。范围小多了，但这里、这里，两个交点都说得通。
cues.en: Add another distance. Much better, but there are still two crossings. Either could be you.

cues.zh: 第三个距离来了。它排掉另一个可能，把位置钉在了这里。
cues.en: A third distance rules out the other possibility. Now the position is pinned down.

cues.zh: 到三维，圆就变成球面。
cues.en: In three dimensions, circles become spheres.

cues.zh: 但接收机的时钟不够准。扣掉共同的偏差，四个球面，终于在这里会合。
cues.en: The receiver's clock is imperfect. Remove that shared bias, and all four spheres finally meet right here.

cues.zh: 按下回车，浏览器先找地址，再建立连接、协商加密。看，小请求已经出发了。
cues.en: Press Enter. First the address, then a connection, then encryption. Watch the little request make its journey.

cues.zh: 内容到了，还得把代码画成页面。你看到的网页，是这样一点点出现的。
cues.en: The content has arrived. Now the browser turns code into pixels, building the page piece by piece.

cues.zh: 再访问一次，连接还在。前面几次来回，就可以省下了。
cues.en: Visit again while the connection is open. Those first few round trips disappear.

cues.zh: 如果本地的缓存还新鲜呢？这次，连远门都不用出了。
cues.en: And if the local cache is still fresh? This time, the browser hardly needs to go anywhere.

cues.zh: 盯住这小块图像。中间这些明暗花纹，就是拆开它的积木。
cues.en: Focus on this tiny image block. Those brightness patterns are the building blocks hidden inside it.

cues.zh: 只留平均亮度，整块就成了灰色。细节去哪了？被我们拿掉了。
cues.en: Keep only average brightness. Just gray. Where did the detail go? We took it away.

cues.zh: 先放回变化慢的部分。看，大轮廓回来了。它不需要一开始就有所有细节。
cues.en: Bring back the slowly changing patterns first. The broad outline returns, even before all the fine detail.

cues.zh: 再加变化快的部分，边缘清楚了。现在，看看右边。
cues.en: Add faster changes. Sharper edges. Keep your eye on the right.

cues.zh: 量化变粗，细节又丢了。这次，回不来了。
cues.en: Coarser quantization. Detail is lost for good.

cues.zh: 猫爱吃，后面接什么？先别替它回答。这个小模型，现在还没学会。
cues.en: Cat likes eating. What comes next? Don't help it yet. This little model hasn't learned.

cues.zh: 让它猜，再对照答案。猜错带来的误差，沿着梯度传回去，权重就调整了一点。
cues.en: Let it guess, then compare with the answer. Gradients carry that error backward, nudging the weights.

cues.zh: 再来几轮。看鱼的概率，往上走了。下面的误差，也在慢慢降。
cues.en: A few more rounds. Watch fish become more likely, while the error below comes down.

cues.zh: 训练停在这里。猜出一个字，接回上下文，再继续猜。
cues.en: Stop training here. Pick a token, append it, then predict again.

cues.zh: 注意，生成时，权重一直没动。
cues.en: Watch the counter. Generation never updates the weights.

cues.zh: 先拿一条线。往一个新的方向推开它，看，正方形就出现了。
cues.en: Take a line. Move it in a new direction, and watch a square appear.

cues.zh: 再把正方形往第三个方向推。这次，扫出来的是一个立方体。
cues.en: Push that square in a third direction. This time, it sweeps out a cube.

cues.zh: 同样的办法，再多一个独立方向，就得到四维超立方体。数一数，多了多少条边？
cues.en: Repeat the idea in one more independent direction: a tesseract. Notice how many more edges appear.

cues.zh: 它一转，内外好像交换了。其实变化的是投影，我们没有真的看见第四个方向。
cues.en: As it turns, inside and outside seem to trade places. That's the projection changing, not a fourth direction on your screen.

cues.zh: 松手。看摆球往下走，高度在减少，速度却越来越快。
cues.en: Let go. As the bob drops, it loses height and picks up speed.

cues.zh: 最低处最快，但它不会停在那里。冲到另一边，速度又换回了高度。
cues.en: Fastest at the bottom, but it doesn't stop there. Up the other side, speed turns back into height.

cues.zh: 我们换一条长线。还是同样的重力，这一来一回，却明显慢下来了。
cues.en: Let's use a longer string. Same gravity, but each trip there and back now takes longer.

cues.zh: 再加点阻尼。每次回来都矮一点，机械能正一点点交给周围。
cues.en: Now add damping. Each return is a little lower. Mechanical energy is passing into the surroundings.

cues.zh: 看这些乘客，我们把他们的到达时间固定下来。先试最直观的办法：谁先到，就先处理谁。
cues.en: Watch these passengers. We'll keep their arrival times fixed. First, the obvious rule: deal with the oldest request first.

cues.zh: 同一批人，再来一次。这回优先接最近的任务。电梯少跑一点，并不保证每个人都少等。
cues.en: Same people, same arrivals. This time, take the nearest task. Less travel doesn't automatically mean less waiting for everyone.

cues.zh: 第三回，沿着一个方向，顺路接人。先别急着选赢家，等这一批乘客都送完。
cues.en: Third try: keep a direction and collect people along the way. Wait for everyone to arrive before picking a winner.

cues.zh: 同样的输入，才比得公平。
cues.en: Same inputs. Now it's a fair comparison.

cues.zh: 没有路口，也没有事故。大家原本都开得好好的。
cues.en: No junctions, no accident. Everyone starts out moving smoothly.

cues.zh: 看金色那辆车，轻点一下刹车。后面的车，也不得不慢下来。
cues.en: Watch the gold car tap its brakes. The driver behind has to slow down too.

cues.zh: 有意思的来了：车还在往前开，拥堵却往后传。每个人，都在接着前一个人的减速。
cues.en: Here's the strange part. Cars go forward, but the jam travels backward. Each driver inherits the slowdown ahead.

cues.zh: 看时空图里的斜纹。它记录的，正是这股往后走的减速波，不是某一辆停住的车。
cues.en: Those diagonal traces record the backward-moving wave. The jam is a moving pattern, not one car stuck in place.
